from __future__ import annotations

from unittest import mock

import pendulum
import pytest
from sqlalchemy import delete, select

from airflow._shared.timezones import timezone
from airflow.jobs.job import Job
from airflow.jobs.scheduler_job_runner import SchedulerJobRunner
from airflow.models.asset import AssetEvent, AssetPartitionDagRun, PartitionedAssetKeyLog
from airflow.models.backfill import Backfill, BackfillDagRun, ReprocessBehavior
from airflow.models.dag import DagModel
from airflow.models.dagrun import DagRun
from airflow.models.log import Log
from airflow.models.taskinstance import TaskInstance
from airflow.providers.standard.operators.empty import EmptyOperator
from airflow.sdk import Asset, IdentityMapper
from airflow.sdk.definitions.timetables.assets import PartitionedAssetTimetable
from airflow.timetables.simple import PartitionedAtRuntime
from airflow.utils.state import DagRunState, DagSchedulingState, State
from airflow.utils.types import DagRunType

from tests_common.test_utils.db import clear_db_apdr, clear_db_backfills, clear_db_pakl
from tests_common.test_utils.mock_executor import MockExecutor

pytestmark = pytest.mark.db_test


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def refuse_to_run_test_from_wrongly_named_files():
    """Probe files must be named aih_probe*, so the repo's file-name guard is overridden here."""


def _runner():
    return SchedulerJobRunner(
        job=Job(job_type=SchedulerJobRunner.job_type), executors=[MockExecutor(do_update=False)]
    )


def _make_dag(dag_maker, session, dag_id, state, run_state=None):
    with dag_maker(dag_id=dag_id, schedule="@daily", session=session):
        EmptyOperator(task_id="t")
    run = dag_maker.create_dagrun(state=run_state) if run_state else None
    session.get(DagModel, dag_id).set_scheduling_state(state)
    session.flush()
    return run


@pytest.mark.need_serialized_dag
def test_probe_partitioned_event_ignored_while_draining(dag_maker, session):
    clear_db_apdr()
    clear_db_pakl()
    asset = Asset(name="probe-asset")
    with dag_maker(
        dag_id="probe-consumer",
        schedule=PartitionedAssetTimetable(assets=asset, default_partition_mapper=IdentityMapper()),
        session=session,
    ):
        EmptyOperator(task_id="hi")
    session.commit()

    with dag_maker(dag_id="probe-producer", schedule=PartitionedAtRuntime(), session=session) as dag:
        EmptyOperator(task_id="hi", outlets=[asset])
    dr = dag_maker.create_dagrun(partition_key="2026-05-20T01:00:00", session=session)
    [ti] = dr.get_task_instances(session=session)
    session.commit()
    TaskInstance.register_asset_changes_in_db(
        ti=ti,
        task_outlets=[o.asprofile() for o in dag.get_task("hi").outlets],
        outlet_events=[],
        session=session,
    )
    session.commit()
    event = session.scalar(select(AssetEvent).where(AssetEvent.source_dag_id == "probe-producer"))
    apdr = session.scalar(
        select(AssetPartitionDagRun)
        .join(
            PartitionedAssetKeyLog,
            PartitionedAssetKeyLog.asset_partition_dag_run_id == AssetPartitionDagRun.id,
        )
        .where(PartitionedAssetKeyLog.asset_event_id == event.id)
    )

    session.get(DagModel, "probe-consumer").set_scheduling_state(DagSchedulingState.DRAINING)
    session.commit()
    assert _runner()._create_dagruns_for_partitioned_asset_dags(session=session) == set()
    session.refresh(apdr)
    assert apdr.created_dag_run_id is None
    assert session.scalars(select(DagRun).where(DagRun.dag_id == "probe-consumer")).all() == []

    session.get(DagModel, "probe-consumer").set_scheduling_state(DagSchedulingState.ACTIVE)
    session.commit()
    assert _runner()._create_dagruns_for_partitioned_asset_dags(session=session) == {"probe-consumer"}


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("state", "expected_queued"),
    [(DagSchedulingState.DRAINING, True), (DagSchedulingState.ACTIVE, True), (DagSchedulingState.PAUSED, False)],
)
def test_probe_tis_queued_by_scheduling_state(dag_maker, session, state, expected_queued):
    dag_id = f"probe_queue_{state.value}"
    dr = _make_dag(dag_maker, session, dag_id, state, DagRunState.RUNNING)
    (ti,) = dr.task_instances
    ti.state = State.SCHEDULED
    session.flush()

    res = _runner()._executable_task_instances_to_queued(max_tis=32, session=session)

    assert ([queued.key for queued in res] == [ti.key]) is expected_queued
    session.rollback()


def test_probe_manual_run_can_be_created_for_draining_dag(dag_maker, session):
    _make_dag(dag_maker, session, "probe_manual", DagSchedulingState.DRAINING)
    dr = dag_maker.create_dagrun(
        run_id="manual_run", run_type=DagRunType.MANUAL, state=DagRunState.RUNNING, session=session
    )
    assert dr.run_type == DagRunType.MANUAL
    assert session.get(DagModel, "probe_manual").scheduling_state == DagSchedulingState.DRAINING


def test_probe_finalize_pauses_idle_and_logs(dag_maker, session):
    clear_db_backfills()
    session.execute(delete(Log))
    _make_dag(dag_maker, session, "probe_idle", DagSchedulingState.DRAINING)
    _make_dag(dag_maker, session, "probe_done", DagSchedulingState.DRAINING, DagRunState.FAILED)
    _make_dag(dag_maker, session, "probe_active", DagSchedulingState.ACTIVE)
    _make_dag(dag_maker, session, "probe_paused", DagSchedulingState.PAUSED)

    _runner()._finalize_draining_dags(session)
    session.flush()
    session.expire_all()

    for dag_id in ("probe_idle", "probe_done", "probe_paused"):
        dag = session.get(DagModel, dag_id)
        assert (dag.is_paused, dag.is_draining) == (True, False)
    assert session.get(DagModel, "probe_active").scheduling_state == DagSchedulingState.ACTIVE
    logs = session.scalars(select(Log).where(Log.event == "drain_completed").order_by(Log.dag_id)).all()
    assert [(log.dag_id, log.owner) for log in logs] == [("probe_done", "scheduler"), ("probe_idle", "scheduler")]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("run_state", [DagRunState.QUEUED, DagRunState.RUNNING])
def test_probe_finalize_keeps_dags_with_unfinished_runs(dag_maker, session, run_state):
    clear_db_backfills()
    session.execute(delete(Log))
    _make_dag(dag_maker, session, "probe_busy", DagSchedulingState.DRAINING, run_state)

    _runner()._finalize_draining_dags(session)
    session.flush()
    session.expire_all()

    assert session.get(DagModel, "probe_busy").scheduling_state == DagSchedulingState.DRAINING
    assert session.scalars(select(Log).where(Log.event == "drain_completed")).all() == []


def test_probe_finalize_waits_for_backfill_without_runs(dag_maker, session):
    clear_db_backfills()
    _make_dag(dag_maker, session, "probe_bf", DagSchedulingState.DRAINING)
    backfill = Backfill(
        dag_id="probe_bf",
        from_date=pendulum.parse("2021-01-01"),
        to_date=pendulum.parse("2021-01-03"),
        max_active_runs=10,
        dag_run_conf={},
        reprocess_behavior=ReprocessBehavior.NONE,
    )
    session.add(backfill)
    session.flush()

    _runner()._finalize_draining_dags(session)
    session.flush()
    session.expire_all()
    assert session.get(DagModel, "probe_bf").scheduling_state == DagSchedulingState.DRAINING

    dag_run = DagRun(
        dag_id="probe_bf",
        run_id="backfill__2021-01-01T00:00:00+00:00",
        run_type=DagRunType.BACKFILL_JOB,
        logical_date=pendulum.parse("2021-01-01"),
        data_interval=(pendulum.parse("2021-01-01"), pendulum.parse("2021-01-02")),
        run_after=pendulum.parse("2021-01-02"),
        state=DagRunState.RUNNING,
        backfill_id=backfill.id,
    )
    session.add(dag_run)
    session.flush()
    session.add(
        BackfillDagRun(
            backfill_id=backfill.id,
            dag_run_id=dag_run.id,
            logical_date=pendulum.parse("2021-01-01"),
            sort_ordinal=1,
        )
    )
    session.flush()

    _runner()._finalize_draining_dags(session)
    session.flush()
    session.expire_all()

    return dag.scheduling_state.value, dag.is_paused, dag.is_draining


def test_probe_response_defaults_and_reflects_draining(test_client, session):
    body = test_client.get(f"/dags/{A}").json()
    assert body["scheduling_state"] == "active"
    assert test_client.get(f"/dags/{A}/details").json()["scheduling_state"] == "active"

    session.get(DagModel, A).set_scheduling_state(DagSchedulingState.DRAINING)
    session.commit()
    for url in (f"/dags/{A}", f"/dags/{A}/details"):
        body = test_client.get(url).json()
        assert body["scheduling_state"] == "draining"
        assert body["is_paused"] is False
    listed = {d["dag_id"]: d for d in test_client.get("/dags").json()["dags"]}
    assert listed[A]["scheduling_state"] == "draining"

        ({"scheduling_state": "paused"}, ("paused", True, False)),

)

    response = test_client.patch(f"/dags/{A}", json=body)

    assert response.json()["scheduling_state"] == expected[0]

)

    response = test_client.patch(url, json=body, params={"dag_id_pattern": "~"})
    assert response.status_code == 422
    assert _state(session, A) == ("active", False, False)

def test_probe_update_mask_must_match_body(test_client, url, body, mask, status):

    assert response.status_code == status

        (DagSchedulingState.PAUSED, {"scheduling_state": "draining"}, ("draining", False, True)),

        (DagSchedulingState.DRAINING, {"is_paused": True}, ("paused", True, False)),
        (DagSchedulingState.DRAINING, {"is_paused": False}, ("active", False, False)),
    ],
)
@pytest.mark.parametrize("single", [True, False])
def test_probe_patch_sets_both_flags(test_client, session, initial, body, expected, single):
    for dag_id in (A, B):

        assert {d["scheduling_state"] for d in response.json()["dags"]} == {expected[0]}
        assert _state(session, A) == expected
        assert _state(session, B) == expected


def test_probe_manual_trigger_allowed_while_draining(test_client, session):

    session.commit()

    response = test_client.post(f"/dags/{A}/dagRuns", json={"logical_date": "2030-01-01T00:00:00Z"})

    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest
from sqlalchemy import select

from airflow.models.dag import DagModel
from airflow.models.dagrun import DagRun
from airflow.providers.standard.operators.empty import EmptyOperator
from airflow.utils.state import DagSchedulingState

from tests_common.test_utils.db import clear_db_dags, clear_db_runs, clear_db_serialized_dags

pytestmark = pytest.mark.db_test

A, B = "probe_api_a", "probe_api_b"


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def refuse_to_run_test_from_wrongly_named_files():
    """Probe files must be named aih_probe*, so the repo's file-name guard is overridden here."""


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def two_dags(dag_maker, session):
    clear_db_runs()
    clear_db_dags()
    clear_db_serialized_dags()
    for dag_id in (A, B):
        with dag_maker(dag_id, schedule=None):
            EmptyOperator(task_id="t")
        dag_maker.sync_dagbag_to_db()
    session.commit()
    yield
    clear_db_runs()
    clear_db_dags()
    clear_db_serialized_dags()


def _state(session, dag_id):
    session.expire_all()
    dag = session.get(DagModel, dag_id)
    return dag.scheduling_state.value, dag.is_paused, dag.is_draining


def test_probe_response_defaults_and_reflects_draining(test_client, session):
    body = test_client.get(f"/dags/{A}").json()
    assert body["scheduling_state"] == "active"
    assert test_client.get(f"/dags/{A}/details").json()["scheduling_state"] == "active"

    session.get(DagModel, A).set_scheduling_state(DagSchedulingState.DRAINING)
    session.commit()
    for url in (f"/dags/{A}", f"/dags/{A}/details"):
        body = test_client.get(url).json()
        assert body["scheduling_state"] == "draining"
        assert body["is_paused"] is False
    listed = {d["dag_id"]: d for d in test_client.get("/dags").json()["dags"]}
    assert listed[A]["scheduling_state"] == "draining"
    assert listed[B]["scheduling_state"] == "active"


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("body", "expected"),
    [
        ({"scheduling_state": "draining"}, ("draining", False, True)),
        ({"scheduling_state": "draining", "is_paused": None}, ("draining", False, True)),
        ({"is_paused": True, "scheduling_state": None}, ("paused", True, False)),
        ({"is_paused": False}, ("active", False, False)),
        ({"scheduling_state": "paused"}, ("paused", True, False)),
    ],
)
def test_probe_patch_one_field(test_client, session, body, expected):
    response = test_client.patch(f"/dags/{A}", json=body)
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.json()["scheduling_state"] == expected[0]
    assert response.json()["is_paused"] is expected[1]
    assert _state(session, A) == expected
    assert _state(session, B) == ("active", False, False)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "body",
    [
        {"is_paused": True, "scheduling_state": "paused"},
        {"is_paused": False, "scheduling_state": "active"},
        {},
        {"is_paused": None},
        {"scheduling_state": None},
        {"is_paused": None, "scheduling_state": None},
    ],
)
@pytest.mark.parametrize("url", [f"/dags/{A}", "/dags"])
def test_probe_patch_needs_exactly_one_field(test_client, session, body, url):
    response = test_client.patch(url, json=body, params={"dag_id_pattern": "~"})
    assert response.status_code == 422
    assert _state(session, A) == ("active", False, False)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("url", [f"/dags/{A}", "/dags"])
@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("body", "mask", "status"),
    [
        ({"scheduling_state": "draining"}, ["scheduling_state"], 200),
        ({"is_paused": True}, ["is_paused"], 200),
        ({"is_paused": True}, ["scheduling_state"], 422),
        ({"scheduling_state": "draining"}, ["is_paused"], 422),
        ({"is_paused": None, "scheduling_state": "draining"}, ["is_paused"], 422),
    ],
)
def test_probe_update_mask_must_match_body(test_client, url, body, mask, status):
    response = test_client.patch(url, json=body, params={"update_mask": mask, "dag_id_pattern": "~"})
    assert response.status_code == status


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("initial", "body", "expected"),
    [
        (DagSchedulingState.ACTIVE, {"scheduling_state": "draining"}, ("draining", False, True)),
        (DagSchedulingState.PAUSED, {"scheduling_state": "draining"}, ("draining", False, True)),
        (DagSchedulingState.DRAINING, {"scheduling_state": "active"}, ("active", False, False)),
        (DagSchedulingState.DRAINING, {"is_paused": True}, ("paused", True, False)),
        (DagSchedulingState.DRAINING, {"is_paused": False}, ("active", False, False)),
    ],
)
@pytest.mark.parametrize("single", [True, False])
def test_probe_patch_sets_both_flags(test_client, session, initial, body, expected, single):
    for dag_id in (A, B):
        session.get(DagModel, dag_id).set_scheduling_state(initial)
    session.commit()

    if single:
        response = test_client.patch(f"/dags/{A}", json=body)
        assert response.status_code == 200
        assert response.json()["scheduling_state"] == expected[0]
        assert _state(session, A) == expected
        assert _state(session, B)[0] == initial.value
    else:
        response = test_client.patch("/dags", json=body, params={"dag_id_pattern": "~"})
        assert response.status_code == 200
        assert {d["scheduling_state"] for d in response.json()["dags"]} == {expected[0]}
        assert _state(session, A) == expected
        assert _state(session, B) == expected


def test_probe_manual_trigger_allowed_while_draining(test_client, session):
    session.get(DagModel, A).set_scheduling_state(DagSchedulingState.DRAINING)
    session.commit()

    response = test_client.post(f"/dags/{A}/dagRuns", json={"logical_date": "2030-01-01T00:00:00Z"})

    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
    assert session.scalars(select(DagRun).where(DagRun.dag_id == A)).all()
    assert _state(session, A) == ("draining", False, True)

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

import pytest
from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError

from airflow.models.dag import DagModel
from airflow.models.dagrun import DagRun
from airflow.providers.standard.operators.empty import EmptyOperator
from airflow.utils.state import DagRunState, DagSchedulingState

pytestmark = pytest.mark.db_test

DATE = datetime(2016, 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc)


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def refuse_to_run_test_from_wrongly_named_files():
    """Probe files must be named aih_probe*, so the repo's file-name guard is overridden here."""


def _new_dag(dag_id, **kwargs):
    return DagModel(
        dag_id=dag_id,
        bundle_name="testing",
        max_active_tasks=1,
        has_task_concurrency_limits=False,
        is_stale=False,
        **kwargs,
    )


def test_probe_scheduling_state_flags(session, testing_dag_bundle):
    dag = _new_dag("probe_flags")
    session.add(dag)
    session.flush()
    assert dag.is_draining is False
    assert dag.scheduling_state == DagSchedulingState.ACTIVE

    dag.set_scheduling_state(DagSchedulingState.DRAINING)
    assert (dag.is_paused, dag.is_draining) == (False, True)
    assert dag.scheduling_state == DagSchedulingState.DRAINING

    dag.set_scheduling_state("paused")
    assert (dag.is_paused, dag.is_draining) == (True, False)
    assert dag.scheduling_state == DagSchedulingState.PAUSED

    dag.set_scheduling_state(DagSchedulingState.ACTIVE)
    assert (dag.is_paused, dag.is_draining) == (False, False)
    session.flush()


def test_probe_scheduling_state_is_read_only():
    with pytest.raises(AttributeError):
        DagModel(dag_id="x").scheduling_state = DagSchedulingState.PAUSED


def test_probe_db_rejects_paused_and_draining(session, testing_dag_bundle):
    session.add(_new_dag("probe_both", is_paused=True, is_draining=True))
    with pytest.raises(IntegrityError):
        session.flush()
    session.rollback()


def test_probe_dags_needing_dagruns_skips_draining(session, testing_dag_bundle):
    session.add(
        _new_dag("probe_due_active", next_dagrun=DATE, next_dagrun_create_after=DATE + timedelta(days=1))
    )
    session.add(
        _new_dag("probe_due_draining", next_dagrun=DATE, next_dagrun_create_after=DATE + timedelta(days=1))
    )
    session.flush()
    session.get(DagModel, "probe_due_draining").set_scheduling_state(DagSchedulingState.DRAINING)
    session.flush()

    query, _ = DagModel.dags_needing_dagruns(session)
    ids = {d.dag_id for d in query.all()}
    assert "probe_due_active" in ids
    assert "probe_due_draining" not in ids


def test_probe_auto_pause_clears_draining(dag_maker, session):
    with dag_maker("probe_auto_pause", schedule=None, session=session):
        EmptyOperator(task_id="t")
    dr = dag_maker.create_dagrun(state=DagRunState.FAILED)
    session.get(DagModel, "probe_auto_pause").set_scheduling_state(DagSchedulingState.DRAINING)
    session.flush()

    dr._check_last_n_dagruns_failed("probe_auto_pause", 1, session)
    session.expire_all()

    dag = session.get(DagModel, "probe_auto_pause")
    assert dag.is_paused is True
    assert dag.is_draining is False


def test_probe_draining_runs_still_examined(dag_maker, session):
    with dag_maker("probe_examined", schedule=None, session=session):
        EmptyOperator(task_id="t")
    running = dag_maker.create_dagrun(run_id="r", state=DagRunState.RUNNING, session=session)
    queued = dag_maker.create_dagrun(
        run_id="q", logical_date=DATE + timedelta(days=1), state=DagRunState.QUEUED, session=session
    )
    session.get(DagModel, "probe_examined").set_scheduling_state(DagSchedulingState.DRAINING)
    session.commit()

    examined = DagRun.get_running_dag_runs_to_examine(session=session, eagerly_load_dag_tags=False).all()
    assert running in examined
    assert queued in DagRun.get_queued_dag_runs_to_set_running(session).all()

    session.get(DagModel, "probe_examined").set_scheduling_state(DagSchedulingState.PAUSED)
    session.commit()
    assert running not in DagRun.get_running_dag_runs_to_examine(
        session=session, eagerly_load_dag_tags=False
    ).all()

from __future__ import annotations

from unittest import mock

import pendulum
import pytest
from sqlalchemy import delete, select

from airflow.jobs.job import Job
from airflow.jobs.scheduler_job_runner import SchedulerJobRunner
from airflow.models.asset import AssetEvent, AssetPartitionDagRun, PartitionedAssetKeyLog
from airflow.models.backfill import Backfill, BackfillDagRun, ReprocessBehavior
from airflow.models.dag import DagModel
from airflow.models.dagrun import DagRun
from airflow.models.log import Log
from airflow.models.taskinstance import TaskInstance
from airflow.providers.standard.operators.empty import EmptyOperator
from airflow.sdk import Asset, IdentityMapper
from airflow.sdk.definitions.timetables.assets import PartitionedAssetTimetable
from airflow.timetables.simple import PartitionedAtRuntime
from airflow.utils.state import DagRunState, DagSchedulingState, State
from airflow.utils.types import DagRunType

from tests_common.test_utils.db import clear_db_apdr, clear_db_backfills, clear_db_pakl
from tests_common.test_utils.mock_executor import MockExecutor

pytestmark = pytest.mark.db_test


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def refuse_to_run_test_from_wrongly_named_files():
    """Probe files must be named aih_probe*, so the repo's file-name guard is overridden here."""


def _runner():
    return SchedulerJobRunner(
        job=Job(job_type=SchedulerJobRunner.job_type), executors=[MockExecutor(do_update=False)]
    )


def _make_dag(dag_maker, session, dag_id, state, run_state=None):
    with dag_maker(dag_id=dag_id, schedule="@daily", session=session):
        EmptyOperator(task_id="t")
    run = dag_maker.create_dagrun(state=run_state) if run_state else None
    session.get(DagModel, dag_id).set_scheduling_state(state)
    session.flush()
    return run


@pytest.mark.need_serialized_dag
def test_probe_partitioned_event_ignored_while_draining(dag_maker, session):
    clear_db_apdr()
    clear_db_pakl()
    asset = Asset(name="probe-asset")
    with dag_maker(
        dag_id="probe-consumer",
        schedule=PartitionedAssetTimetable(assets=asset, default_partition_mapper=IdentityMapper()),
        session=session,
    ):
        EmptyOperator(task_id="hi")
    session.commit()

    with dag_maker(dag_id="probe-producer", schedule=PartitionedAtRuntime(), session=session) as dag:
        EmptyOperator(task_id="hi", outlets=[asset])
    dr = dag_maker.create_dagrun(partition_key="2026-05-20T01:00:00", session=session)
    [ti] = dr.get_task_instances(session=session)
    session.commit()
    TaskInstance.register_asset_changes_in_db(
        ti=ti,
        task_outlets=[o.asprofile() for o in dag.get_task("hi").outlets],
        outlet_events=[],
        session=session,
    )
    session.commit()
    event = session.scalar(select(AssetEvent).where(AssetEvent.source_dag_id == "probe-producer"))
    apdr = session.scalar(
        select(AssetPartitionDagRun)
        .join(
            PartitionedAssetKeyLog,
            PartitionedAssetKeyLog.asset_partition_dag_run_id == AssetPartitionDagRun.id,
        )
        .where(PartitionedAssetKeyLog.asset_event_id == event.id)
    )

    session.get(DagModel, "probe-consumer").set_scheduling_state(DagSchedulingState.DRAINING)
    session.commit()
    assert _runner()._create_dagruns_for_partitioned_asset_dags(session=session) == set()
    session.refresh(apdr)
    assert apdr.created_dag_run_id is None
    assert session.scalars(select(DagRun).where(DagRun.dag_id == "probe-consumer")).all() == []

    session.get(DagModel, "probe-consumer").set_scheduling_state(DagSchedulingState.ACTIVE)
    session.commit()
    assert _runner()._create_dagruns_for_partitioned_asset_dags(session=session) == {"probe-consumer"}


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("state", "expected_queued"),
    [(DagSchedulingState.DRAINING, True), (DagSchedulingState.ACTIVE, True), (DagSchedulingState.PAUSED, False)],
)
def test_probe_tis_queued_by_scheduling_state(dag_maker, session, state, expected_queued):
    dag_id = f"probe_queue_{state.value}"
    dr = _make_dag(dag_maker, session, dag_id, state, DagRunState.RUNNING)
    (ti,) = dr.task_instances
    ti.state = State.SCHEDULED
    session.flush()

    res = _runner()._executable_task_instances_to_queued(max_tis=32, session=session)

    assert ([queued.key for queued in res] == [ti.key]) is expected_queued
    session.rollback()


def test_probe_manual_run_can_be_created_for_draining_dag(dag_maker, session):
    _make_dag(dag_maker, session, "probe_manual", DagSchedulingState.DRAINING)
    dr = dag_maker.create_dagrun(
        run_id="manual_run", run_type=DagRunType.MANUAL, state=DagRunState.RUNNING, session=session
    )
    assert dr.run_type == DagRunType.MANUAL
    assert session.get(DagModel, "probe_manual").scheduling_state == DagSchedulingState.DRAINING


def test_probe_finalize_pauses_idle_and_logs(dag_maker, session):
    clear_db_backfills()
    session.execute(delete(Log))
    _make_dag(dag_maker, session, "probe_idle", DagSchedulingState.DRAINING)
    _make_dag(dag_maker, session, "probe_done", DagSchedulingState.DRAINING, DagRunState.FAILED)
    _make_dag(dag_maker, session, "probe_active", DagSchedulingState.ACTIVE)
    _make_dag(dag_maker, session, "probe_paused", DagSchedulingState.PAUSED)

    _runner()._finalize_draining_dags(session)
    session.flush()
    session.expire_all()

    for dag_id in ("probe_idle", "probe_done", "probe_paused"):
        dag = session.get(DagModel, dag_id)
        assert (dag.is_paused, dag.is_draining) == (True, False)
    assert session.get(DagModel, "probe_active").scheduling_state == DagSchedulingState.ACTIVE
    logs = session.scalars(select(Log).where(Log.event == "drain_completed").order_by(Log.dag_id)).all()
    assert [(log.dag_id, log.owner) for log in logs] == [("probe_done", "scheduler"), ("probe_idle", "scheduler")]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("run_state", [DagRunState.QUEUED, DagRunState.RUNNING])
def test_probe_finalize_keeps_dags_with_unfinished_runs(dag_maker, session, run_state):
    clear_db_backfills()
    session.execute(delete(Log))
    _make_dag(dag_maker, session, "probe_busy", DagSchedulingState.DRAINING, run_state)

    _runner()._finalize_draining_dags(session)
    session.flush()
    session.expire_all()

    assert session.get(DagModel, "probe_busy").scheduling_state == DagSchedulingState.DRAINING
    assert session.scalars(select(Log).where(Log.event == "drain_completed")).all() == []


def test_probe_finalize_waits_for_backfill_without_runs(dag_maker, session):
    clear_db_backfills()
    _make_dag(dag_maker, session, "probe_bf", DagSchedulingState.DRAINING)
    backfill = Backfill(
        dag_id="probe_bf",
        from_date=pendulum.parse("2021-01-01"),
        to_date=pendulum.parse("2021-01-03"),
        max_active_runs=10,
        dag_run_conf={},
        reprocess_behavior=ReprocessBehavior.NONE,
    )
    session.add(backfill)
    session.flush()

    _runner()._finalize_draining_dags(session)
    session.flush()
    session.expire_all()
    assert session.get(DagModel, "probe_bf").scheduling_state == DagSchedulingState.DRAINING

    dag_run = DagRun(
        dag_id="probe_bf",
        run_id="backfill__2021-01-01T00:00:00+00:00",
        run_type=DagRunType.BACKFILL_JOB,
        logical_date=pendulum.parse("2021-01-01"),
        data_interval=(pendulum.parse("2021-01-01"), pendulum.parse("2021-01-02")),
        run_after=pendulum.parse("2021-01-02"),
        state=DagRunState.RUNNING,
        backfill_id=backfill.id,
    )
    session.add(dag_run)
    session.flush()
    session.add(
        BackfillDagRun(
            backfill_id=backfill.id,
            dag_run_id=dag_run.id,
            logical_date=pendulum.parse("2021-01-01"),
            sort_ordinal=1,
        )
    )
    session.flush()

    _runner()._finalize_draining_dags(session)
    session.flush()
    session.expire_all()
    # a backfill with runs no longer holds the drain open itself; the running run does
    assert session.get(DagModel, "probe_bf").scheduling_state == DagSchedulingState.DRAINING

    session.get(DagRun, dag_run.id).state = DagRunState.SUCCESS
    session.flush()
    _runner()._finalize_draining_dags(session)
    session.flush()
    session.expire_all()
    assert session.get(DagModel, "probe_bf").scheduling_state == DagSchedulingState.PAUSED


def test_probe_finalize_orders_by_dag_id_and_respects_limit(dag_maker, session):
    clear_db_backfills()
    session.execute(delete(DagModel).where(DagModel.is_draining.is_(True)))
    for dag_id in ("probe_z", "probe_x", "probe_y"):
        _make_dag(dag_maker, session, dag_id, DagSchedulingState.DRAINING)

    with mock.patch.object(DagModel, "NUM_DAGS_PER_DAGRUN_QUERY", 2):
        _runner()._finalize_draining_dags(session)
    session.flush()
    session.expire_all()

    assert session.get(DagModel, "probe_x").scheduling_state == DagSchedulingState.PAUSED
    assert session.get(DagModel, "probe_y").scheduling_state == DagSchedulingState.PAUSED
    assert session.get(DagModel, "probe_z").scheduling_state == DagSchedulingState.DRAINING

import pytest

from airflow.assets.manager import AssetManager

)
from airflow.models.dag import DagModel
from airflow.sdk.definitions.asset import Asset
from airflow.utils.state import DagSchedulingState

from tests_common.test_utils.db import clear_db_assets, clear_db_dags

pytestmark = pytest.mark.db_test


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def refuse_to_run_test_from_wrongly_named_files():
    """Probe files must be named aih_probe*, so the repo's file-name guard is overridden here."""


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def clean():
    clear_db_assets()
    clear_db_dags()
    yield
    clear_db_assets()
    clear_db_dags()


@pytest.mark.parametrize("only_draining", [False, True])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("via", ["asset", "alias", "name_ref", "uri_ref"])
def test_probe_draining_dag_not_queued(session, testing_dag_bundle, via, only_draining):
    dags = []
    if not only_draining:
        dags.append(DagModel(dag_id="probe_mgr_active", bundle_name="testing", is_stale=False))
    draining = DagModel(dag_id="probe_mgr_draining", bundle_name="testing", is_stale=False)
    draining.set_scheduling_state(DagSchedulingState.DRAINING)
    dags.append(draining)
    session.add_all(dags)

    asm = AssetModel(uri="test://probe/", name="probe_asset", group="asset")
    session.add(asm)
    alias_names = []
    if via == "asset":
        asm.scheduled_dags = [DagScheduleAssetReference(dag_id=d.dag_id) for d in dags]
    elif via == "alias":
        alias = AssetAliasModel(name="probe_alias", group="test")
        session.add(alias)
        alias.scheduled_dags = [DagScheduleAssetAliasReference(alias_id=alias.id, dag_id=d.dag_id) for d in dags]
        alias_names = ["probe_alias"]
    elif via == "name_ref":
        session.add_all(DagScheduleAssetNameReference(name="probe_asset", dag_id=d.dag_id) for d in dags)
    else:

from sqlalchemy import delete, select

from airflow.jobs.job import Job

from airflow.models.asset import AssetEvent, AssetPartitionDagRun, PartitionedAssetKeyLog
from airflow.models.backfill import Backfill, BackfillDagRun, ReprocessBehavior
from airflow.models.dag import DagModel

from airflow.models.log import Log
from airflow.models.taskinstance import TaskInstance
from airflow.providers.standard.operators.empty import EmptyOperator
from airflow.sdk import Asset, IdentityMapper
from airflow.sdk.definitions.timetables.assets import PartitionedAssetTimetable
from airflow.timetables.simple import PartitionedAtRuntime
from airflow.utils.state import DagRunState, DagSchedulingState, State
from airflow.utils.types import DagRunType

from tests_common.test_utils.db import clear_db_apdr, clear_db_backfills, clear_db_pakl
from tests_common.test_utils.mock_executor import MockExecutor

pytestmark = pytest.mark.db_test


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def refuse_to_run_test_from_wrongly_named_files():
    """Probe files must be named aih_probe*, so the repo's file-name guard is overridden here."""


def _runner():
    return SchedulerJobRunner(
        job=Job(job_type=SchedulerJobRunner.job_type), executors=[MockExecutor(do_update=False)]
    )


def _make_dag(dag_maker, session, dag_id, state, run_state=None):
    with dag_maker(dag_id=dag_id, schedule="@daily", session=session):
        EmptyOperator(task_id="t")
    run = dag_maker.create_dagrun(state=run_state) if run_state else None
    session.get(DagModel, dag_id).set_scheduling_state(state)
    session.flush()
    return run


@pytest.mark.need_serialized_dag
def test_probe_partitioned_event_ignored_while_draining(dag_maker, session):
    clear_db_apdr()
    clear_db_pakl()
    asset = Asset(name="probe-asset")
    with dag_maker(
        dag_id="probe-consumer",
        schedule=PartitionedAssetTimetable(assets=asset, default_partition_mapper=IdentityMapper()),
        session=session,
    ):
        EmptyOperator(task_id="hi")
    session.commit()

    with dag_maker(dag_id="probe-producer", schedule=PartitionedAtRuntime(), session=session) as dag:
        EmptyOperator(task_id="hi", outlets=[asset])
    dr = dag_maker.create_dagrun(partition_key="2026-05-20T01:00:00", session=session)
    [ti] = dr.get_task_instances(session=session)
    session.commit()
    TaskInstance.register_asset_changes_in_db(
        ti=ti,
        task_outlets=[o.asprofile() for o in dag.get_task("hi").outlets],
        outlet_events=[],
        session=session,
    )
    session.commit()
    event = session.scalar(select(AssetEvent).where(AssetEvent.source_dag_id == "probe-producer"))
    apdr = session.scalar(
        select(AssetPartitionDagRun)
        .join(
            PartitionedAssetKeyLog,
            PartitionedAssetKeyLog.asset_partition_dag_run_id == AssetPartitionDagRun.id,
        )
        .where(PartitionedAssetKeyLog.asset_event_id == event.id)
    )

    session.get(DagModel, "probe-consumer").set_scheduling_state(DagSchedulingState.DRAINING)
    session.commit()
    assert _runner()._create_dagruns_for_partitioned_asset_dags(session=session) == set()
    session.refresh(apdr)
    assert apdr.created_dag_run_id is None
    assert session.scalars(select(DagRun).where(DagRun.dag_id == "probe-consumer")).all() == []

    session.get(DagModel, "probe-consumer").set_scheduling_state(DagSchedulingState.ACTIVE)
    session.commit()
    assert _runner()._create_dagruns_for_partitioned_asset_dags(session=session) == {"probe-consumer"}


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("state", "expected_queued"),
    [(DagSchedulingState.DRAINING, True), (DagSchedulingState.ACTIVE, True), (DagSchedulingState.PAUSED, False)],
)
def test_probe_tis_queued_by_scheduling_state(dag_maker, session, state, expected_queued):
    dag_id = f"probe_queue_{state.value}"
    dr = _make_dag(dag_maker, session, dag_id, state, DagRunState.RUNNING)
    (ti,) = dr.task_instances
    ti.state = State.SCHEDULED
    session.flush()

    res = _runner()._executable_task_instances_to_queued(max_tis=32, session=session)

    assert ([queued.key for queued in res] == [ti.key]) is expected_queued
    session.rollback()


def test_probe_manual_run_can_be_created_for_draining_dag(dag_maker, session):
    _make_dag(dag_maker, session, "probe_manual", DagSchedulingState.DRAINING)
    dr = dag_maker.create_dagrun(
        run_id="manual_run", run_type=DagRunType.MANUAL, state=DagRunState.RUNNING, session=session
    )
    assert dr.run_type == DagRunType.MANUAL
    assert session.get(DagModel, "probe_manual").scheduling_state == DagSchedulingState.DRAINING


def test_probe_finalize_pauses_idle_and_logs(dag_maker, session):
    clear_db_backfills()
    session.execute(delete(Log))
    _make_dag(dag_maker, session, "probe_idle", DagSchedulingState.DRAINING)
    _make_dag(dag_maker, session, "probe_done", DagSchedulingState.DRAINING, DagRunState.FAILED)
    _make_dag(dag_maker, session, "probe_active", DagSchedulingState.ACTIVE)
    _make_dag(dag_maker, session, "probe_paused", DagSchedulingState.PAUSED)

    _runner()._finalize_draining_dags(session)
    session.flush()
    session.expire_all()

    for dag_id in ("probe_idle", "probe_done", "probe_paused"):
        dag = session.get(DagModel, dag_id)
        assert (dag.is_paused, dag.is_draining) == (True, False)
    assert session.get(DagModel, "probe_active").scheduling_state == DagSchedulingState.ACTIVE
    logs = session.scalars(select(Log).where(Log.event == "drain_completed").order_by(Log.dag_id)).all()
    assert [(log.dag_id, log.owner) for log in logs] == [("probe_done", "scheduler"), ("probe_idle", "scheduler")]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("run_state", [DagRunState.QUEUED, DagRunState.RUNNING])
def test_probe_finalize_keeps_dags_with_unfinished_runs(dag_maker, session, run_state):
    clear_db_backfills()
    session.execute(delete(Log))
    _make_dag(dag_maker, session, "probe_busy", DagSchedulingState.DRAINING, run_state)

    _runner()._finalize_draining_dags(session)
    session.flush()
    session.expire_all()

    assert session.get(DagModel, "probe_busy").scheduling_state == DagSchedulingState.DRAINING
    assert session.scalars(select(Log).where(Log.event == "drain_completed")).all() == []


def test_probe_finalize_waits_for_backfill_without_runs(dag_maker, session):
    clear_db_backfills()
    _make_dag(dag_maker, session, "probe_bf", DagSchedulingState.DRAINING)
    backfill = Backfill(
        dag_id="probe_bf",
        from_date=pendulum.parse("2021-01-01"),
        to_date=pendulum.parse("2021-01-03"),
        max_active_runs=10,
        dag_run_conf={},
        reprocess_behavior=ReprocessBehavior.NONE,
    )
    session.add(backfill)
    session.flush()

    _runner()._finalize_draining_dags(session)
    session.flush()
    session.expire_all()
    assert session.get(DagModel, "probe_bf").scheduling_state == DagSchedulingState.DRAINING

    dag_run = DagRun(
        dag_id="probe_bf",
        run_id="backfill__2021-01-01T00:00:00+00:00",
        run_type=DagRunType.BACKFILL_JOB,
        logical_date=pendulum.parse("2021-01-01"),
        data_interval=(pendulum.parse("2021-01-01"), pendulum.parse("2021-01-02")),
        run_after=pendulum.parse("2021-01-02"),
        state=DagRunState.RUNNING,
        backfill_id=backfill.id,
    )
    session.add(dag_run)
    session.flush()
    session.add(
        BackfillDagRun(
            backfill_id=backfill.id,
            dag_run_id=dag_run.id,
            logical_date=pendulum.parse("2021-01-01"),
            sort_ordinal=1,
        )
    )
    session.flush()

    _runner()._finalize_draining_dags(session)
    session.flush()
    session.expire_all()
    # a backfill with runs no longer holds the drain open itself; the running run does
    assert session.get(DagModel, "probe_bf").scheduling_state == DagSchedulingState.DRAINING

    session.get(DagRun, dag_run.id).state = DagRunState.SUCCESS
    session.flush()
    _runner()._finalize_draining_dags(session)
    session.flush()
    session.expire_all()
    assert session.get(DagModel, "probe_bf").scheduling_state == DagSchedulingState.PAUSED


def test_probe_finalize_orders_by_dag_id_and_respects_limit(dag_maker, session):
    clear_db_backfills()
    session.execute(delete(DagModel).where(DagModel.is_draining.is_(True)))

from __future__ import annotations

import json

import pytest

from airflow.cli import cli_parser
from airflow.cli.commands import dag_command
from airflow.models.dag import DagModel
from airflow.providers.standard.operators.empty import EmptyOperator
from airflow.utils.state import DagSchedulingState

from tests_common.test_utils.db import clear_db_dags, clear_db_runs, clear_db_serialized_dags

pytestmark = pytest.mark.db_test

IDS = ("probe_cli_a", "probe_cli_b", "probe_cli_c")


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def refuse_to_run_test_from_wrongly_named_files():
    """Probe files must be named aih_probe*, so the repo's file-name guard is overridden here."""


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def cli_dags(dag_maker, session):
    clear_db_runs()
    clear_db_dags()
    clear_db_serialized_dags()
    for dag_id in IDS:
        with dag_maker(dag_id, schedule=None, serialized=True):
            EmptyOperator(task_id="t")
    session.commit()
    yield
    clear_db_runs()
    clear_db_dags()
    clear_db_serialized_dags()


def _flags(session, dag_id):
    session.expire_all()
    dag = session.get(DagModel, dag_id)
    return dag.is_paused, dag.is_draining


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("verb", "initial", "expected"),
    [
        ("pause", DagSchedulingState.DRAINING, (True, False)),
        ("pause", DagSchedulingState.ACTIVE, (True, False)),
        ("unpause", DagSchedulingState.DRAINING, (False, False)),
        ("unpause", DagSchedulingState.PAUSED, (False, False)),
    ],
)
def test_probe_pause_unpause_sets_both_flags(session, capsys, verb, initial, expected):
    session.get(DagModel, "probe_cli_a").set_scheduling_state(initial)
    session.commit()

    getattr(dag_command, f"dag_{verb}")(cli_parser.get_parser().parse_args(["dags", verb, "probe_cli_a"]))

    out = capsys.readouterr().out
    assert "probe_cli_a" in out
    assert "were found" not in out
    assert _flags(session, "probe_cli_a") == expected


def test_probe_unpause_of_active_and_pause_of_paused_change_nothing(session, capsys):
    session.get(DagModel, "probe_cli_b").set_scheduling_state(DagSchedulingState.PAUSED)
    session.commit()

    dag_command.dag_pause(cli_parser.get_parser().parse_args(["dags", "pause", "probe_cli_b"]))
    assert "were found" in capsys.readouterr().out
    dag_command.dag_unpause(cli_parser.get_parser().parse_args(["dags", "unpause", "probe_cli_c"]))
    assert "were found" in capsys.readouterr().out


def test_probe_regex_pause_catches_draining_dags(session):
    session.get(DagModel, "probe_cli_a").set_scheduling_state(DagSchedulingState.DRAINING)
    session.get(DagModel, "probe_cli_b").set_scheduling_state(DagSchedulingState.PAUSED)
    session.commit()

    dag_command.dag_unpause(
        cli_parser.get_parser().parse_args(["dags", "unpause", "probe_cli_.*", "--treat-dag-id-as-regex", "--yes"])
    )

    for dag_id in IDS:
        assert _flags(session, dag_id) == (False, False)


def test_probe_details_include_scheduling_state(session, capsys):
    session.get(DagModel, "probe_cli_a").set_scheduling_state(DagSchedulingState.DRAINING)
    session.commit()

    dag_command.dag_details(
        cli_parser.get_parser().parse_args(["dags", "details", "probe_cli_a", "--output", "json"])
    )

    assert json.loads(capsys.readouterr().out)[0]["scheduling_state"] == "draining"
